title: Countries and territories
scope: Global — ISO 3166-1 codes, regions, capitals, currencies, languages
notes: Generated from an openly licensed dataset. Reference facts only; no trade rules.

title: Country coverage levels
scope: Global — states how deep eport's guidance is for each country
notes: Maintained by eport. Every country not listed is a reference record only.

title: World map geometry
scope: Global — generalised country boundaries at 1:110m
notes: Natural Earth public-domain geometry. Boundaries are generalised for display and carry no political endorsement.

title: Hero globe land dots
scope: Decorative dot grid derived from Natural Earth land outlines
notes: Used only for the decorative home-page globe. Not vessel, port or trade data.

title: International organizations
scope: International — 10 organizations central to trade and shipping
notes: Editorial summaries with links to each organization's official website. More organizations and industry associations to follow.

title: India — national trade authorities
scope: India — central (national) authorities only
notes: Seed directory. State-level bodies, export promotion councils and port authorities are not yet included.

title: Trade and economic indicators
scope: World aggregate and economies with World Bank data — exports, imports, GDP and trade share of GDP, from 2000
notes: Build-time snapshot of World Bank World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0). Annual historical statistics; not every economy reports every indicator.

title: Source registry
scope: Every publisher referenced by an eport record
notes: Each record on eport cites one or more entries in this registry.

title: API provider registry
scope: External data services evaluated for browser use
notes: Browser access is recorded only from an actual cross-origin test.

title: Trade Knowledge Graph index
scope: Relationships between countries, authorities and organizations
notes: Derived from the relations declared on published records. Grows as documents, ports, products and agreements are added.

title: Search index
scope: All published records and live pages
notes: Compact index built from published datasets at build time.

title: Trade documents library
scope: Global documents with India-specific detail
notes: Schema defined. Content is being researched against official sources and is not yet published.

title: Trade requirements and procedures
scope: India first, then priority trading partners
notes: Not yet published. eport will not show a requirement without an official source.

title: HS classification (international 6-digit)
scope: International HS, kept separate from national tariff lines
notes: Not yet published. Licensing of the HS nomenclature text is under review.

title: Tariffs and duties
scope: By origin, destination and HS code
notes: Not available. eport does not display tariff rates without a verifiable official source and validity date.

title: Global port directory
scope: Global seaports with UN/LOCODE
notes: Not yet published.

title: Vessel information and positions
scope: Depends on provider coverage
notes: No global open vessel feed can be used from a static site. A regional (Finland) layer is approved; global tracking needs a secure integration layer.

title: Shipping lines and logistics organizations
scope: Global
notes: Not yet published.

title: Buyer and supplier directories
scope: Global
notes: Not yet published. Listings will carry an explicit verification status.

title: Trade events and opportunities
scope: Global
notes: Not yet published. eport does not list events or tenders without an official link.

title: Trade news headlines
scope: Latest headlines from five official publishers (WTO, ITC, European Commission, ICC, UN News)
notes: Headline, publisher abstract, date and link only. Refreshed daily by a scheduled job; topic tags are applied automatically. Not a complete view of trade news.

title: Detailed country shapes (1:50m)
scope: Country outlines for the country-page map; 14 very small territories have no outline
notes: Natural Earth public-domain geometry. Territories without an outline are shown as a marker. Boundaries carry no political endorsement.

title: Featured countries by region
scope: Largest economies per region by exports of goods and services
notes: Computed from the World Bank indicator snapshot; drives the Countries menu.

title: Country process guides
scope: India only — a ten-stage overview of exporting and importing, linked to the responsible authorities
notes: eport editorial overview marked "needs review": not yet compared line by line with the official sources. Other countries are not published.

title: Official explainer videos
scope: Videos from the WTO, WCO, ITC, IMO and ICC channels, verified against YouTube oEmbed
notes: General explainers, not specific to a country. Only videos uploaded by the organization or its own national committee/academy are listed; each loads from YouTube only when played.
